evidence.title: Free Website Builder Software with AI

name: Mobirise
summary: Free desktop website builder with drag-and-drop blocks and AI page generation.
description: Downloadable Windows and Mac app that builds websites from pre-made blocks: drag blocks onto a page, edit text and media inline, then publish to Mobirise hosting or a custom domain. Includes AI website generation, Bootstrap themes, forms, galleries, sliders, popup, chat and shop extensions and a code editor.
contains: free website builder app for Windows and Mac
AI website generation from a text prompt
10,000+ website blocks in free and premium themes
100+ Bootstrap and AMP themes and extensions
extensions: forms, popup, chat, shopping cart, code editor
free for personal and commercial use
